answer: The nadir schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the pulse checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. Someone wanting 175 effective identities must lock that capital for 77 epochs and keep it locked through every ocean audit. Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 77 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. That is 19 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
